title: Apk Extractor
shortDescription: App backup, version history, XAPK installer, move apps to a new phone. No root.
tagline: Extract APK files, back up apps and install APK/XAPK — all in one toolkit

sections.title: Extract APK files, back up apps and install APK/XAPK — all in one toolkit
paragraphs: APK Extractor & App Manager is a fast, lightweight APK extractor, app backup tool, APK/XAPK installer, app manager and APK analyzer. Extract installed apps as APK files, keep a version history to roll back a bad update, install split APK (XAPK) packages, move your apps to a new phone and share apps offline — no root required.

sections.title: Back Up Apps Before a Reset or a New Phone
bullets: Share apps with friends offline — no internet or app store needed
Move your apps to a new phone, or back up before a factory reset
Keep an APK of the current version before an app updates
Save apps no longer available in the app store

sections.title: APK Extractor & App Backup
bullets: Extract APK files from user apps and system apps
Batch backup many apps at once, without root access
Pick a custom export folder on internal or external storage

sections.title: Version History, Auto Backup & Downgrade
bullets: Auto backup: watch chosen apps and keep an APK of every new version
Set how many versions to keep per app — all stored on your device
Reinstall an older version and roll back an update you did not want

sections.title: APK Installer, XAPK Installer & Batch Install
bullets: Install APK files with the Android package installer
Install XAPK packages made of a base APK and split APK files
Batch install: queue several APK or XAPK files and run them in one go
Clear reasons when installs fail — incompatible ABI, min API, low space

sections.title: Device Migration: Move Apps to a New Phone
bullets: Send the app list — and the APK/XAPK files themselves — from the old phone to the new one over Wi-Fi
The new phone checks what it already has, then installs everything back in one queue
Flags versions you already have, different signatures and apps it cannot run
Store-installed apps get a one-tap link to their store page

sections.title: Version Compare & Signature Check
bullets: Compare an APK file with the version already installed
See whether signatures match or come from a different publisher
Spot added or removed permissions before you install

sections.title: Powerful App Manager
bullets: Browse user apps and system apps in a list or grid
Search by app name or package name
Launch, open system app info, visit the store page or uninstall

sections.title: APK Analyzer & App Info
bullets: Package name, version name, version code, min SDK and target SDK
App size, APK path, installer, install time and update time
Signature certificate plus MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 and CRC32 checksums

sections.title: App Statistics & Device Health
bullets: Compare user and system apps by count, total size and average size
Find the largest, oldest and most recently updated apps
See which apps request location, camera, microphone or contacts

sections.title: Share Apps, Wi-Fi Transfer & Web Transfer
bullets: Send apps and APK files via the share menu — Quick Share, Bluetooth, email
Transfer apps between devices on the same Wi-Fi, no internet needed
Web transfer: open an address or scan a QR code in a browser to move apps between phone and computer

sections.title: Export Path, File Naming Rules & ZIP Compression
paragraphs: Set the export folder, APK naming rules, ZIP compression, scan range, sharing mode, language and dark mode to match your workflow.

sections.title: Privacy First, No Root Needed
paragraphs: APK extraction, backup and app management need no root. Optional Usage Access is used only for cache and unused-app insights. Auto backup, batch install, web transfer, ad-free and device migration beyond the first 5 apps are part of a one-time Pro purchase.

sections.title: An APK extractor to save APK files, a backup tool for switching phones, an XAPK installer for split APKs — download APK Extractor & App Manager and take control of your apps.
